gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: A record whose value count does not match its parser's header mapping is reported as inconsistent, while its size and position accessors still return the values
ADDED i2: The header has two columns, but both use the same name. Because the header map keys are unique, the parser ends up with a single mapping.
ADDED i3: Build a record with two values but only one distinct header mapping.
ADDED i4: The record carries two values, but the header maps only one column, so the sizes disagree and the record is inconsistent.
ADDED i5: The position values are returned exactly as supplied.
